ordering: target size, h, representation, source; then six repeats, rotating six methods by condition index + repeat.
size_shortfall_policy: Retain undersized full package as an actual-size descriptive condition. Identical normalized root SET across size targets is measured once; other targets remain aliases and target size shortfalls, never evidence at their requested size.
analysis_rule: Per-condition median across six repeats; separated improvement if median ratio>1.05 and all six comparison times are below all six reference times. Descriptive variation screen, not significance test. Report source strata, all failures and complete denominators; do not infer population significance from repeated h/representation rows.
